response:
{
  "requirement_type": "greenfield",
  "intent": "Build a production-grade, scalable URL shortener service that exposes APIs for creating and resolving short URLs, persists data reliably, and provides usage analytics.",
  "functional_requirements": [
    "Accept a long URL via API and return a unique shortened URL",
    "Redirect users from a short URL to the original long URL",
    "Support custom alias/slug creation for short URLs",
    "Track click analytics including timestamp, IP address, user agent, and referrer",
    "Provide an API endpoint to retrieve analytics data for a given short URL",
    "Support URL expiration with configurable TTL per short URL",
    "Validate input URLs to ensure they are well-formed and reachable",
    "Support bulk URL shortening via a batch API endpoint",
    "Allow deletion or deactivation of a short URL by its owner",
    "Provide an API to list all short URLs created by a specific user or API key"
  ],
  "non_functional_requirements": [
    "High availability with at least 99.9% uptime SLA for redirect service",
    "Low latency redirects with p99 response time under 50ms",
    "Horizontally scalable to handle at least 10,000 redirects per second",
    "Secure API access via API keys or OAuth2 tokens",
    "Data durability with persistent storage and backup strategy",
    "Analytics pipeline should not block or degrade redirect performance",
    "Short URL codes must be collision-resistant and unpredictable",
    "Rate limiting to prevent abuse of the URL creation and redirect endpoints",
    "GDPR/privacy compliance for storing user and analytics data"
  ],
  "ambiguities": [
    "No specification of the short URL code length or character set (e.g., Base62, 6 chars vs 8 chars)",
    "Authentication model is unspecified — anonymous usage vs. user accounts vs. API key only",
    "Analytics granularity and retention period are not defined",
    "No clarity on whether custom domains (vanity domains) are supported for short URLs",
    "The target infrastructure or cloud provider is not specified",
    "No definition of what 'scalable' means in terms of concrete traffic numbers",
    "It is unclear whether the service is multi-tenant or single-tenant",
    "No specification of the tech stack or language preference"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Short URL codes will be 7-character Base62 alphanumeric strings generated via a hash or counter-based approach",
    "Authentication will use API keys for programmatic access with optional user account registration",
    "Analytics data will be retained for 90 days by default with aggregated summaries kept indefinitely",
    "Custom vanity domains are out of scope for the initial version",
    "The service will be deployed on a major cloud provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) using containerized microservices",
    "Scalability target is defined as supporting up to 10,000 redirects/sec and 1,000 URL creations/sec",
    "The service is multi-tenant, with each tenant identified by an API key",
    "A relational database (e.g., PostgreSQL) will be used for URL persistence and a cache layer (e.g., Redis) for hot redirects"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Short URLs must be globally unique across the system",
    "Redirect endpoint must not introduce significant latency — cache-first architecture required",
    "Analytics writes must be asynchronous to avoid impacting redirect latency",
    "The system must handle hash collisions gracefully with a retry or fallback mechanism",
    "All data at rest and in transit must be encrypted",
    "The API must be versioned (e.g., /v1/) to support future evolution without breaking changes",
    "Infrastructure must support zero-downtime deployments"
  ],
  "clarification_questions": [
    "What are the expected peak traffic volumes (redirects per second and URL creations per day)?",
    "Should the service support user accounts and authentication, or is API key access sufficient?",
    "What analytics dimensions are required — clicks over time, geographic data, device/browser breakdown?",
    "Is support for custom aliases and/or custom domains (vanity domains) required?",
    "What is the preferred cloud provider and any existing infrastructure constraints?",
    "What is the required data retention period for analytics and URL records?",
    "Should expired or deleted URLs return a 404 or redirect to a configurable fallback page?",
    "Is there a requirement for a web-based dashboard UI, or is API-only sufficient for the initial release?",
    "Are there any compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA) that must be addressed?",
    "What is the preferred technology stack or are there any language/framework constraints?"
  ],
  "normalized_problem": "Design and implement a production-grade, horizontally scalable URL shortener service exposing RESTful APIs for URL creation, resolution, and management, backed by a durable persistent store with a caching layer for high-throughput redirects. The system must support multi-tenant API key authentication, asynchronous click analytics collection, configurable URL expiration, and be deployable on cloud infrastructure with high availability, rate limiting, and sub-50ms p99 redirect latency."
}
